comments.body:
Florentine casting recipe "Crusades armour casting method" (World Clock: 16th Century, Phases 1 through 3) -- speak to Metalcaster. R0 Casting; costs 400 casting consumption to make.

Ingredients:
Leather x5
Leather Cord x10
Pure Iron Sheet x15
3k total fame to equip, no gender restrictions, color-custom.

Stats:
+1 Guard
+1 Leadership
